es.title: Rain in the Redwood Forest 8 Hours 🌲 Sleep, Study and Relax
es.description:
8 hours of gentle rain in the Redwood Forest of California for deep sleep, focused studying, or pure relaxation. An immersive sound that transports you beneath the tallest trees on Earth.

🌲 What you'll find in this video:
- 8 uninterrupted hours of forest rain
- Gentle rain on ancient redwoods
- No music, no voice, just pure nature
- Immersive Californian forest ambience

✅ Perfect for:
✔ Sleeping deeply all night
✔ Studying or working with maximum focus
✔ Relaxing after a long day
✔ Meditating or practicing mindfulness
✔ Blocking unwanted outside noise

🔔 Subscribe for more relaxing nature sounds.

⏱️ Duration: 8 hours | 📺 Full HD 1080p
